text.index.ts: Registers command groups, the palette among them, into typed command ids, rejecting duplicate, malformed or mis-prefixed ids and shortcuts without mod or an F-key, and looks commands up by id.
text.index.ts gotcha: The command id type holds only because the prefix and duplicate checks run when the module loads.
text.key-syntax.ts: Normalizes a shortcut string into ordered modifiers plus one printable character or F-key, and tells whether a key is safe to dispatch, which needs mod or an F-key.
text.key-syntax.ts gotcha: Keys such as space or up are rejected because a key event could never match them.
text.keymap-settings.ts: Declares the Keyboard shortcuts category: the list of key and command entries layered over the default shortcuts.
text.keymap.ts: Resolves default and user shortcut bindings into key-to-command and command-to-key maps, matches key presses to commands for a platform, and formats shortcuts as per-platform labels and chips (symbols on mac, words on windows and linux, Enter as a return symbol on mac), menu accelerators and ARIA strings.
text.nodes.ts: Declares the command groups: palette, settings, projects, editor, Lantern map (open, refresh, problems, previous and next file), explain (open, pop-out), memory, diagnostics, integrations and skills commands, with their titles, default shortcuts and menu flags.
